rationale: The same Airport-Alpha takeoff gross weight appears twice in the document: once in the detailed W&B table (TOTAL row: 1901.5 lbs) and once in the summary section (Estimated Airport-Alpha Takeoff Values: 1911.5 lbs). A 10-lb numeric drift in the summary is plausible as a transcription error when reformatting the calculation. The moment value (80846.28) is unchanged, making both the weight discrepancy and the inconsistent weight/moment ratio detectable within a single document.

The meteorology report states the accident time as both 'about 1815 Pacific standard time' (PST) and '0115 Universal Coordinated Time (UTC) on March 25, 2019'. PST = UTC-8, so 1815 PST = 0215 UTC, not 0115 UTC. Changing 0215 to 0115 creates an internal contradiction: the UTC and PST representations are offset by one hour and are mutually inconsistent. A meteorologist or analyst could make this one-digit off-by-one error when writing up the UTC equivalent.
